blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Мы перебрались через ___ (овраг) и въехали в слободу.
exercises.why: **Через**, 'through'/'across' - the final preposition has two main meanings. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
exercises.context: Через, 'through'/'across' - the final preposition has two main meanings.

exercises.q: Да всё про ___ (дела) ваши про хорошие.
exercises.why: **Про**, 'about' - this preposition means 'about', in the same way as **о** + *prep* does. — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).  ·  «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.
exercises.context: Про**, 'about' - this preposition means 'about', in the same way as **о + *prep* does.
